# Test fixtures

`ADIF_318_test_QSOs_2026_10_12.adi` and `ADIF_318_test_QSOs_2026_10_12.adx`
are the official test QSO files published by the ADIF Developers Group
with the ADIF 3.1.8 specification resources
(https://www.adif.org/318/ADIF_318_resources.htm, retrieved 2026-11-18).
They are generated from the specification's own tables and are included
here, unmodified, so the test suite can pin adifcheck's behaviour to the
standard's own data. They are the ADIF Developers Group's work, not
covered by this repository's MIT licence.
